resources.string: \'Atomic - Periodic Table\' is a free and open-source application made by me on my spare-time in Sweden. By purchasing the PRO-version you help support the development while also receiving additional data and features!
Thanks for supporting the development of \'Atomic - Periodic Table\'. On this page information about your PRO perks will be available as more PRO features get added.
Explore some of the many features of the PRO-Version and what they include.

Additional data such as hardness properties (mohs-, vickers-, and brinell hardness) as well as sound speed, Poisson Constant, Young\'s-, Bulk- and Shear modulus etc. Also information about identification of minerals.
Additional tables including a nuclide table, poisson\'s ratio table, constants table, geology table etc, with more coming in the future
An enhanced calculator with the possibility to save molar weights of different compounds in the favorite page.
Access to additional flashcards, more lives and syncing of your progress
Enable sync for notes and progress to make your studies easier on all of your devices
Access to more visualisations in the main table such as Poisson\'s Ratio, bulk modulus etc.
